column1: # residency-baseline.tsv - index-region misses per lookup from cachegrind-gate.sh's LRU residency
# model, per geometry (the numbers are part of the key, so editing a geometry cannot reuse an old
# row). v4, v6, both: the routing planes on the dense stream; reputation, tor, rpki-unreachable:
# each default-policy plane ALONE on the default slot's q4 stream, the level stated. Gated within
# +-10% of misses / lookups (a baseline of zero must stay zero); the radix routing plane against
# the LLC is asserted zero whatever this file says. Rows are rewritten per geometry by --write-baseline.
